 This Crl.P, Coming On For Admission, This Day, Order
Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs Justice M G Uma
 Oral Order
Accused Nos.1 and 2 in Cr.No.30/2020 of Mandya Women Police station now pending in Cc
No.5865/2021 on the file of the learned

Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Mandya, are seeking to quash the criminal proceedings initiated against them for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 R/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code (for short 'IPC') and under Section 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 (for short 'DP Act).
2. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that complainant-respondent No.2 is the wife of petitioner No.1 and dispute amongst them is already settled as reported in G and Wc No.2/2021 on the fie of learned Prl.Senior Civil Judge, Mandya.

He refers to the certified copy of the decree passed in the said case, in particular clause (e), which reads as under:
NC: 2024:KHC:45187 "At this stage, respondent has also agreed to get quash the proceedings of Cr.No.30/2020 before the Hon'ble High court of Karnataka,
Bengaluru."

3. G and Wc No.2/2021 on the file of the learned Prl.Senior.Civil Judge and MACT, Mandya was initiated by the petitioner No.1-Nalinkumar H.R., against respondent No.2 herein Chaithrsree M.Y.
Various terms of the settlement are highlighted in the decree dated 31.08.2021 and one of the condition is that respondent-wife has agreed to get quash the proceedings in Cr.No.30/2020 of Mandya Women Police station.
Satisfied with the grounds made out for quashing criminal proceedings.

Hence, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER

The FIR registered in Crime No.30/2020 of Mandya Women Police for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 R/w Section 34 of IPC and under Section 3 and 4 of the DP Act now pending in CC No.5865/2021 on the file of the learned Additional Civil Judge and JMFC,
Mandya, is hereby quashed.
